title: Between a Rock and a Hard Place: Interviews With a Former Double Agent
descriptions: The dataset has been used for an article published in the International Journal of Intelligence and Counterintelligence in 2022. The interviews and the article deal with the precarious position of a double agent who worked for several intelligence services during the Cold War.
